app.description: Web application for meal planning and macronutrient tracking. Features automatic portion recalculation, grocery list consolidation, and parallel prep scheduling.
app.legal: Information is for reference purposes only.

home.title: A meal plan made to fit you
home.subtitle: Set your calorie goal, pick your recipes, and get a balanced plan for every day of the week.

goals.title: Personalized goals
goals.body: Set your daily calorie goal and how many meals you want to have each day.

balance.title: Nutritional balance
balance.body: The app spreads recipes across the day to keep every meal balanced.

flexibility.title: Full flexibility
flexibility.body: Choose which days of the week to follow the plan and adjust portions anytime.

define.title: Set your goals
define.body: Enter your daily calorie goal, choose the days, and the meals you plan to have.

select.title: Pick your recipes
select.body: Browse recipes, filter by category, and select the ones to include in the plan.

plan.title: Get your plan
plan.body: The app builds a balanced plan with portions tailored to hit your goal.

planner.title: Set up your plan
planner.subtitle: Define your calorie goal, the days of the week, and the meals you plan to have.

kcal.label: Daily calorie goal
kcal.hint: Approximate number of calories per day.

days.label: Days of the week
days.hint: Select at least one day to follow the plan.

meals.label: Meals per day
meals.hint: Define the meals and how much of the daily total each should represent.

diet.title: Your meal plan
diet.empty: There are no meals in your plan.

errors.no_recipes: No recipes were selected. Go back and pick at least one.

cooking.empty: There are no steps to cook.

shopping.title: Shopping list
